title: Lachit Barphukan and His Times: A History of the Assam-Mogul Conflicts (1947)
title_english: Lachit Barphukan and His Times: A History of the Assam-Mogul Conflicts (1947)
title_tai: လႃႉၶိတ်ႉ ၿႃႇၽူႇၵၼ်ႇ လႄႈ ပၢၼ် မၼ်း ၸဝ်ႈ
author: Dr. Suryya Kumar Bhuyan, M.A., Ph.D. (London)
genre: Military Monograph / Biographical History / Saraighat Campaign
category: Department of Historical and Antiquarian Studies (DHAS) Master Monograph
provenance: Gauhati: DHAS / Government of Assam / Internet Archive (in.ernet.dli.2015.528968)
description: Comprehensive historical and military masterpiece by Dr. S. K. Bhuyan documenting the life, military doctrine, and naval strategy of General Lachit Barphukan. Draws upon contemporary Ahom and Assamese Buranjis, Persian padshahnama chronicles, and diplomatic correspondence to provide a detailed tactical analysis of the 1667-1671 war of liberation culminating in the naval Battle of Saraighat on the Brahmaputra River.
